failures.triage_note: All Ads, Slot Inventory, Ad Analytics and Settings screens each emit exactly 1 <hr class="wp-header-end">, but Ad Folders (edit.php?post_type=wbam-ad&page=wbam-folders) emits 0. The custom-rendered Ad Folders screen never outputs the marker WP core's insertAfter() looks for, so any admin_notice added to that screen (e.g. a plugin-conflict or update notice) will render in the wrong place instead of directly under the H1. Verified via document.querySelectorAll('hr.wp-header-end').length on the live screen; folder listing itself (counts, unpublished-ad status labels) is otherwise correct.
failures.expected: Exactly one <hr class="wp-header-end"> on every WBAM admin screen, per D4.
failures.actual: 0 <hr class="wp-header-end"> elements on the Ad Folders screen.

failures.triage_note: Root cause in includes/Modules/Classifieds/class-report-admin.php lines 637 and 640: `esc_url( get_permalink( $classified->post_id ) )` and `esc_url( get_edit_post_link( $classified->post_id ) )` are called unconditionally. When the reported classified's post has been deleted, get_permalink()/get_edit_post_link() return false/null, esc_url(null) triggers a PHP 8.1+ deprecation inside WP core's sanitize_url() (ltrim() on null), and the 'View Listing'/'Edit Listing' buttons render as clickable links with href="" instead of D11's required plain-text fallback. Reproduced live on report_id=1 (report for a classified whose post_id resolves to 0/deleted): both anchors have empty href, the 'Reported Classified' heading/status block is empty, and a matching debug.log deprecation appeared at the exact moment of the page load (10:30:28 UTC): "PHP Deprecated: ltrim(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($string) of type string ... wp-includes/formatting.php on line 4558".
failures.expected: A report whose classified was deleted renders 'View Listing'/'Edit Listing' as plain text (or omits them), with no PHP 8.1+ deprecation logged.
failures.actual: Both links render as clickable buttons with href="", and a ltrim(): Passing null deprecation is logged on every page view.

failures.triage_note: Root cause in templates/portal/tabs/wallet.php line 483: the Credit History transaction list does `echo esc_html( $amount_prefix . number_format( $amount ) )` where $amount is `(int) $entry->amount` (line 434) — the raw MINOR-UNIT (cents) value straight from wp_wbam_credit_ledger, with no division by 100 and no currency symbol. Every other amount on the same page (balance, campaign spend, credit-pack prices) correctly calls wbam_format_price(). This is the exact anti-pattern the KNOWN CONTEXT flags: a ledger row of amount=1000 (=$10.00) displays as "+10"; amount=-2999 (=-$29.99) displays as "-29"; amount=50 (=$0.50) displays as "+0", silently disappearing a small credit. Verified live on TechStartup's Wallet tab against the wp_wbam_credit_ledger rows for user_id=12.
failures.expected: Credit History entries render via wbam_format_price(), e.g. "+$10.00", "-$29.99", "+$0.50".
failures.actual: Credit History entries render as bare truncated integers with no currency symbol or decimals: "+10", "-29", "+0" (for a real $0.50 top-up).
